recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source edit is needed in FHIR core; future JSON template generator work should preserve resourceType only for resource templates, not ordinary datatype templates.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 change request to remove the confusing resourceType entry from the JSON Template for Address, ContactPoint, HumanName, and Timing because those artifacts are datatypes rather than resources.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 13057. The corresponding git-svn commit d24d7a6ff7d41be72c3c1daa463fc4c06b805968, titled '#14475 - fix JSON templates', changed the historical JsonSpecGenerator so resourceType was emitted only when the root name was a resource or Parameters. The historical generator files are no longer present in the current checkout.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Address, ContactPoint, HumanName, and Timing as active current types. Current datatype spreadsheet sources identify them as DataType or BackboneType roots and contain no resourceType child. Grep over the combined branch's datatype page and these four datatype sources found no resourceType occurrence; the only nearby datatype-page resourceType occurrence is an unrelated ValueSet example in datatypes-examples.html. Jira search found only FHIR-14475 for the exact request, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no human discussion or later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the requested correction was already applied historically and no current FHIR core source change is needed.
